serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
New email from… Emily Grossberg? Isn’t she this bitch from highschool? She hated my guts back then. She and her groupies were always making fun of me. 
Class meetup? No thanks. Why would I meet with classmates that I never got close to? I had some friends back then, but paying 100$ only to meet them is stupid. 
This idiotic blond chick probably wants to milk money from us anyway.
Oh my God! She even tried to promote her business! Oh honey, the economic crisis must have hit you pretty hard, huh? 
Fuck them.
